s: Dine hachittim utechinatam lematztzot ubo l"g seipim: hammatztza sheadam chayyab leekol belel t"v — tzerika lihyot meechad mechameshet mine dagan, shehem: chittim useorim vekusmin veshibbolet shual veshipon. Abal im asa matztza meorez o dochan o shear mine qitniyyot vaakalah — lo yatza yede chobato, shenneemar "lo tokal alayv chametz shibat yamim tokal matztzot vego'", debarim habbaim lide chimmutz — adam yotze bahem yede chobato im asaan matztza, yatzeu mine qitniyyot vekayyotze bahem sheenam baim lide chimmutz leolam ella lide sirchon, sheapillu im lash adam qemach orez vekayyotze bo berotechin vekissahu bibgadim ad shennitpach kemo batzeq shehechmitz — en zeh chimmutz ella sirchon, vehu muttar baakila, ulepikak ap im asao matztza — eno yotze bo yede chobato:

Umitzva min hammubchar lekattechilla liqqach chittim lematztzat mitzva, velo echad mishshear arbaa mine dagan, veken hamminhag. Veim en lo chittim — yiqqach mishshear mine dagan min hechabib alayv yoter, kede sheyyokal matztza leteabon:

Min hanniqra bilshon ashkenaz tyrqshy"n vvyy"tz — eno min chittim raq lemine qitniyyot yechasheb. Ttrq"y (o hyydy"n o gryq"a) hu mimmine qitniyyot, umuttar laasot mimmennu tabshil bepesach, kemo shemmuttar laasot mishshear mine qitniyyot meiqqar haddin. Abal nahagu bimdinot ellu shello leekol bepesach tabshil shel orez vedochan upolin vaadashim veshumshemim ushear mine qitniyyot apillu beyom tob acharon, lepi shebbaddorot haacharonim rabbu amme haaretz sheenan beqiin beissur vehetter, veim yiru sheokelim bepesach tabshil shel mine qitniyyot — yitu lehattir gam ken tabshil shel mine dagan, hoil vekol hashshana derek laasot tabshil mimmine qitniyyot kemo shedderek mimmine dagan, yidmeh beenehem sheddinam shaveh bepesach, lepikak nahagu leesor hakkol:

Velo nahagu issur ella bemine qitniyyot, shehattabshil hannaaseh mehem mitchallep betabshil hannaaseh mimmine dagan, shehem domim zeh lazeh, sheshshenehem niqraim maaseh qedera, ulekak aseru zeh bishbil zeh. Abal mine zeraim, kegon hashshebet (sheqqorin any"sh) vehakkusbar (sheqqorin alyynd"r) vezera aqlyyz"a, vekayyotze bahem mishshear mine zereone ginna — en nohagin bahem issur. Chutz min hachardal, lepi sheggiddulo hu besharbitin, vahare hu domeh legiddul mine qitniyyot, veneesar biklalam. Vechutz min hakkammon hannimkar bachanut (sheqqorin qaram qimal) shemmebiin oto lekan mimmedinot acherot vegarinayv domeh ledagan, ulekak machamirin bo kemo shemmachamirin bekol mine qitniyyot. Abal min kammon (sheqqorin palad qimal) sheen tzurato doma ledagan — en machamirin bo kelal. Veken kol mine yeraqot — en machamirin bahem, hoil veenan domim kelal ledagan:

Vaapillu bemine qitniyyot lo nahagu ella issur akila im napelu alehem mayim, beinyan shekkayyotze bazeh beHashem mine dagan asur meiqqar haddin, abal muttar lehanot mehem bepesach. Veken muttar lehadliq bishmanim hannaasim mehem (abal hashshemanim sheenam naasim mimmine qitniyyot muttarim apillu baakila) apillu al hashshulchan sheokelim alayv. Veen chosheshin shemma yippol mehashshemen letok hattabshil, sheap im yippol letoko meat shemen — hare hu mitbattel betoko berob, kevan shemminhag issur zeh eno ella chumra beolma. Veap al pi sheqqodem asiyyat hashshemen koteshin oto bemakteshet sheshshorin bah seorim lipamim, mikkol maqom en taam seorim habbalua bammakteshet niplat letok hashshemen al yede ketishato betokah, kevan sheeno dabar charip. Veken muttar lehashhotam immo babbayit apillu nishru bammayim, kegon mine haripot hanniktashin bemakteshet umelachlechin otan bemayim qodem hakketisha. Abal mine haripot shel h' mine dagan hen chametz gamur, veim abar alehem happesach — asurim bahanaa, ella im ken bari lo shello nitlachlechu bemayim qodem hakketisha:

Kol mine zeraim hammuttarim bepesach tzerikin bediqa rabba qodem sheyyaaseh mehem tabshil, libror mehem garine dagan sheddarkan lehimmatze benehem, ulepikak hammachamir shello leekol kammon veshebet ad yom tob haacharon — tabo alayv beraka, ki i epshar leboreram yapeh:

Im erab qemach chittim im qemach orez veasa mehem matztza, im yesh bah taam chittim — hare hi keillu hayeta kullah mechittim, ukesheokel kezayit mimmenna — yotze yede chobato ap al pi sherob kezayit zeh hu orez, lepi shetteba haorez lehiggarer achar hachittim, venishtanna taamo letaam chittim keshehen meorabim immo. Abal im erab qemach chittim im qemach dochan o shear mine qitniyyot, veken im erab qemach shel echad mishshear d' mine dagan im qemach orez veasa mehen matztza, ap al pi sheyyesh bah taam dagan — eno yotze bah yede chobato, ella im ken yesh bah qemach dagan kezayit bikde akilat peras mimmenna, dehaynu shebbekol peras mimmennu yesh bo kezayit qemach dagan, sheaz yotze yede chobato bikzayit mimmenna, lepi shettaam kezayit dagan hannirgash betok happeras shel orez o shear mine qitniyyot mehappek et happeras lihyot kemo dagan mammash, vahare zeh keillu akal kezayit dagan mammash, shehare iqqar haakila hu hattaam, vekevan shettaam taam bikzayit matztza — yatza. Abal im en bematztza zo kezayit dagan bikde akilat peras — en koach betaam haddagan lehappek et mammashut haqqitniyyot lihyot kemo dagan mammash. Veyesh omerim sheapillu matztza hannaaset mittaarobet qemach chittim im qemach orez — en adam yotze bah yede chobato, ella im ken yesh bah kezayit chittim bikde akilat peras. Veim naaset miqqemach chittim im shear mine qitniyyot o miqqemach orez im shear mine dagan, ap al pi sheyyesh bah kezayit dagan bikde akilat peras — eno yotze bah yede choba, sheap shettaam hakkezayit dagan hapak et happeras lihyot kemo dagan mammash, mikkol maqom issa zo lo hayeta baa lide chimmutz leolam, ella im ken haya rubbah dagan, vekol issa sheenah baa lide chimmutz — en yotzein bah yede chobat matztza. Mah sheen ken keshennaaset miqqemach chittim im haorez, shehachittim gorerin et haorez vegoremin lo labo lide chimmutz. Uleinyan halaka — yesh lachosh lekattechilla lisbara acharona lehachamir beshel tora. Abal bishat haddechaq — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, ki ken iqqar:

Chittim sheakelu mehem akbarim venisharu betokan harbeh chittim neshukin meakilat haakbar sheyyesh lachosh bahen shemma nitchammetzu mechamat haroq shebbepi haakbar, sheharoq machmitz kemo mayim kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"v, ap al pi ken en tzarik libror ulehasir hachittim hanneshukim mehachittim hashshelemim, ella tochen hakkol beyachad, veal yede ken mitareb qemach hanneshukim beqemach hashshelemim, venitbattel betoko beshishshim qodem happesach, veshub eno chozer veneor, ap im yopeh mimmenna matztzot betok happesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z. Veen zeh kimbattel issur beyadayim, kevan sheen kavvanato litchon kede lebattel, ella tochen kede leekol, umeelayv hu mitbattel. Veim en bachittim hashshelemim shishshim keneged hanneshukin — lo yitchanem ad sheyyibror mehem hanneshukim (haodepim al hammitbattelin beshishshim). Veim lo bereram vetachan hakkol beyachad — hare zeh muttar, sheqqemach hanneshukin eno oser et qemach hashshelemim bediabad, lepi shehanneshukin atzman en bahem chashash gamur shel chimmutz, shehachittim hem qashim veenam memaharin lehachmitz, verachoq haddabar sheyyitchammetzu mechamat meat roq shebbepi haakbar. Abal im akelu akbarim misseorim (o mishshipon veshibbolet shual) veen shishshim behashshelemim keneged hanneshukin veshakach vetachan hakkol beyachad — yesh lehachamir ulebaaram qodem happesach (ayyen siman tm"b), shehasseorin (veshibbolet shual veshipon) hem rakkim umemaharim lehachmitz, veyesh lachosh shemma nitchammetzu bimat roq shebbepi haakbar:

Chittim shetztzamechu (sheqqorin avy"s giooaqasin) vehen chametz gamur, vahare hen meorabin betok chittim kesherim, im yesh behakkesherim shishshim kenegdan — muttar litchon hakkol beyachad veleepot mehem matztzot apillu betok happesach, kemo shennitbaer. Ulepi dibre haomerim sheqqemach hamorab beqemach yesh letaarobot zeh din taarobet yabesh beyabesh kemo shennitbaer siman tm"z — asur leepot betok happesach, lepi sheqqemach hechametz shennitbattel beqemach hakkasher qodem happesach hu chozer veneor bepesach, kedin yabesh shennitareb venitbattel beyabesh qodem happesach shehu chozer veneor bepesach veoser hattaarobet, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z. Abal kesheopeh qodem happesach — hare naasa kol haqqemach shebbekol matztza umatztza chatika achat mammash al yede haapiyya, ulekak eno chozer veneor bepesach. Vekol baal nepesh yachamir leatzmo lekattechilla lachosh lisbara zo. Umippene kak nitpashshet hamminhag bimdinot ellu leepot kol hammatztzot qodem happesach, lepi sherob hachittim yesh bahem taarobot meat mechittim shetztzamechu:

Vekol zeh kesheyyesh shishshim kenegdan, abal im en shishshim kenegdan — en lahem taqqana, vetzarik lebaaram qodem happesach. Veim abar alehem happesach velo biaran — yimkerem lenokri chutz middeme issur shebbahen kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b. Veen lo lehosip alehem qodem happesach od chittim kesherim velitchon hakkol beyachad kede sheyyitbattel qemach hechametz beshishshim baqqemach hakkasher, sheasur lebattel issur lekattechilla:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechittim shetztzamechu, sheap shennitareb bechittim kesherim nikkarin hen betokan, ulekak enam mitbattelim betokam berob kedin yabesh beyabesh shehu batel berob bekol issure tora. Veken seorin hanneshukin meakilat akbar nikkarin hem betok hashshelemim, ulekak enam mitbattelin betokam berob. Abal dagan shennitchammetz veen chimmutzo nikkar, kegon shennapelu alayv mayim venitbaqqea (ayyen siman ts"z) veachar kak nityabbesh veen biqquo nikkar venitareb bedagan kasher harbeh mimmennu — hare nitbattel betoko berob, vekayyotze bazeh bishar issurin, naasa hakkol hetter gamur, veen kan issur kelal. Lepikak, muttar lehosip alayv od dagan kasher harbeh ad sheyyihyeh shishshim kenegdo, veaz yitchon hakkol beyachad kede sheyyitbattel qemach hechametz beshishshim baqqemach hakkasher qodem happesach, vihe muttar leekol hakkol betok happesach, veen zeh mebattel issur beyadayim kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b:

Vaapillu chitta achat shennapelu aleha mayim venitbaqqea veachar kak nityabbesha venopla letok keri gadol shel chittim, im eno rotzeh letachanam qodem happesach — asur lehashhotam kedin yabesh beyabesh shennitbattel qodem happesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b. Ketzad yaaseh? Im yesh hepsed merubbeh o sheat haddechaq — yasir chitta achat mehakkeri veyoklenna o yashlikenna leibbud qodem happesach, vehashshear muttar lo apillu letachanam betok happesach veleekol, lepi sheyyesh kan b' sepeqot lehaqel: shemma hachitta shenneekla o shenneebda min haolam hi hi hachitta hamchummetzet shennitorba bakkeri, veim timtze lomar sheotah [chitta] adayin hi meorebet bakkeri, mikkol maqom kesheokel bepesach matztza hannaaset mechittim shebbakkeri — yesh lehistappeq al kol chatikat matztza shehu bolea shemma en bachatika zo kelum meotah chitta hamchummetzet, veen baakila zo shum issur kelal, venimtza sheal kol chatikat matztza shehu bolea yesh bah sepeq sepeqa lehaqel velomar sheen baakila zo issur kelal, veheqelu chakamim bispeq sepeqa kazeh, lepi shemmin hattora kebar nitbattel haissur berob yabesh beyabesh. (Veap al pi shebbispeq sepeqa kazeh bishar issurim sheenam mitbattelim berob middibre soperim, kegon chatikat besar terepa vehi chatika gedola vachashuba hareuya lehitkabbed bah lipne haorechim shennitorba beharbeh chatikot besar keshera veneebda achat mehachatikot, sheap shemmuttar lo leekol hashshear bazeh achar zeh mishshum sheyyesh bekol chatika sheokel bo b' sepeqot lehaqel, mikkol maqom asur lo leekol chatika chatika lebaddah, ella tzarik sheyyokal shettayim beyachad bebat achat, dehaynu sheyyiqqach meat mehachatika achat umeat mehachatika acheret veyibleem beyachad bebat achat, kede shebbiblia zo yihyeh bah bevadday hetter barur, sheachat mishshettehen hi bevadday hetter barur, shehare lo nitorba ella chatika achat shel issur. Abal kesheeno bolea ella mechatika achat bilbad — yesh lachosh shemma belia vaakila zo hi kullah mehaissur bilbad veen bah mehahetter, velo ratzu chakamim lismok al b' sepeqot lehaqel bazeh kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"y. Ap al pi ken kan en tzarik leekol b' chatikot matztza beyachad, lepi sheap bachatika achat shehu bolea yesh bah bevadday gam mehahetter, shehare lo nitareb bakkeri ella chitta achat mechummetzet. Lepikak, im nitarebu bakkeri kol kak chittim mechummatzot ad shebbachatikat matztza shehu bolea en bah pi shenayim keneged hachittim hamchummatzot kede sheyyihyeh bachatika zo hetter barur kol kak kemo hachashash issur (mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea sham) — en lo likri zeh taqqana apillu lehashhoto ad leachar happesach, ella al derek shennitbaer besiman tm"b:

Vaapillu lo nitorba ella chitta achat veneekla o neebda qodem happesach — tzarik lizzaher shello yitchon kol hakkeri beyachad betok happesach, shello yitareb kol haqqemach beyachad veyihyeh kullo asur missapeq, shemma nishara chitta hamchummetzet betok hakkeri venitchana immo venitareb qimchah veniblal beqemach kol hakkeri, sheiqqar kedibre haomerim sheqqemach beqemach mitareb veniblal yapeh, veen meat qemach miqqemach hakkeri shello yihyeh bo mashshehu miqqemach hachitta hamchummetzet, veen kan od b' sepeqot lehaqel:

En adam yotze yede chobato ella bematztza sheshshemarah yisrael mechimmutz leshem happesach, shenneemar "ushemartem et hammatztzot", sheyishmerenna yisrael leshem mitzvat matztza. Veyesh omerim: leshem mitzvat "baereb toklu matztzot". Veyesh omerim: leshem mitzvat "shibat yamim toklu matztzot", dehaynu sheim shemarah leshem matztza sheyyoklenna bez' yeme happesach — yotze bah. Veken iqqar:

Umahu shimmur zeh haamur battora? Hu kesheroeh otah qeroba labo lide chimmutz yishmerenna veyishtaddel bah shello tachmitz, kegon mittechillat lishatah vaelak, shekkebar bau aleha mayim vehi qeroba lehachmitz im lo yemaher lehitasseq bah beyadayim belishatah vaarikatah vaapiyyatah — tzarik yisrael ben daat lehitasseq baasaqim hallalu leshem matztza, abal lo nokri velo cheresh shoteh veqatan, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman t"s. Abal qodem shebbau aleha mayim, dehaynu qodem hallisha — en tzarik sheyyishmor yisrael et haddagan o et haqqemach shello yabo alehem mayim, ella kol dagan shebba lepanenu veen anu roin shum chashash chimmutz — muttar letachano lepesach. Veken kol qemach habba lepanenu veen anu roin bo shum chashash chimmutz — muttar lalush mimmennu apillu matztzat mitzva. Veen chosheshin shemma qemach zeh ba mittebua shennopla mayim aleha venitchammetza, ki en machaziqin issur missapeq, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"z:

Vekol zeh meiqqar haddin, abal kebar nahagu kol yisrael lishmor hachittim shel matztzat mitzva mishsheat techina vaelak, lepi sheaz hem qerobim labo lide chimmutz, shehare meqorbin otan el hammayim keshemmebiin otan lebet harechayim shel mayim litchon, vegam keshettochanin berechayim shel yad, regilut hu bishar yemot hashshana lirchotz hachittim qodem techinatan, vehen qerobin labo lide chimmutz, lepikak tzarik sheyyisrael yishmerem mechimmutz bishat hattechina. Abal hattechina atzmah mutteret apillu al yede nokri, kegon berechayim shel yad, raq sheyyisrael ben daat yaamod al gabbayv mittechillat hattechina ad sopah, abal lo cheresh shoteh veqatan. Vehu haddin keshettochanan berechayim shel mayim — lo yishmor sham cheresh shoteh veqatan, ella yisrael gadol shehiggia liklal hammitzvot:

Veim hu sheat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo chittim leshomram mishsheat hattechina vaelak — maamidin al iqqar haddin, umuttar liqqach qemach min hashshuq apillu lematztzat mitzva, veen chosheshin shemma qemach zeh ba mittebua shennapelu aleha mayim, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Umikkol maqom, bimqomot shennohagin lirchotz hachittim qodem hattechina veshohin otan bemayim ezeh zeman — asur liqnot qemach min hashshuq apillu bishat haddechaq, shekkol dagan shennapelu alayv mayim veshahu alayv keshiur mil — hu ba lide chimmutz, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"z:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyadua lanu shemmiqtzat hammokere qemach shebbair darkam lirchotz hachittim tamid qodem hattechina. Veap al pi sherubbam enan rochatzim, mikkol maqom kevan sheen anu makkirim otam sheenan rochatzin — asur lanu lelek etzlam lebattehem veliqqach mehem qemach, kevan shehammokerim hem qebuim bair kol echad veechad bebeto, vekol haqqabua kemechetza al mechetza. Veken asur lelek etzlam lammaqom shehen qebuin bashshuq limkor sham. Abal im en yadua lanu bevadday shemmiqtzat mokere haqqemach regilin lirchotz tamid hachittim — en zeh niqra issur qabua, kevan sheeno issur barur, ulepikak holekin achar rob mokere qemach sheenan rochatzin, umuttar apillu lelek lebattehem liqqach mehem. Umikkol maqom, lo yiqqach min hannachtomim, shebbevadday darkam lirchotz hachittim. Abal qemach shel shear d' mine dagan — muttar liqqach mehem, sheen darkam lirchotz otam. Veken muttar liqqach apillu qemach chittim min bene hakkeparim hambiim bekol yom qemach min hakkeparim, lepi sheen darkam lirchotz hachittim. Veap im yadua lanu shemmiqtzatam rochatzim hachittim — hare pereshu mimmeqom qebiutam, veholekin achar harob sheenan rochatzin. Veken apillu echad mimmokere qemach shebbair shehebi qemach lebet hayyisrael — muttar liqqach mimmennu im yadua lanu sherob hammokerim shebbair enan rochatzim hachittim, dekevan shepperash mimmeqom qebiato — anu tolin lomar shehu min harob sheenan rochatzim. Umikkol maqom, im moker solet neqiyya — asur liqqach otah mimmennu, shebbevadday niblelu hachittim bemayim lehasir qelippatan laasot mehen solet:

Vekol zeh bishat haddechaq, abal shello bishat haddechaq — yisrael qedoshim, venohagin lehachamir apillu bematztzot shel kol yeme happesach lishmor otam mishsheat techina vaelak, velo liqqach qemach min hashshuq apillu bederek hammuttar bishat haddechaq. Abal hachittim shel matztzat mitzva — tob lehachamir im epshar leshomram mishsheat qetzira vaelak shello yippelu alehem mayim, lepi sheyyesh omerim shemmiddibre soperim en adam yotze yede chobato bepesach ella bematztza sheshshemarah yisrael mechimmutz mittechillat shaa shehayeta reuya labo lide chimmutz, dehaynu miyyad bitlishat hashshibbolim mehamchubbar, sheaz im hayu nopelim alehem mayim hayu machmitzin. (Abal beodam bimchubbar — enam baim lide chimmutz im hem tzerikim laqqarqa, kemo shennitbaer besiman ts"z):

Muttar liltot et hachittim, dehaynu shebbolelin otan bemayim qodem hattechina, lepi shekkol zeman shebbolelin otan veoseqin bahem beyadayim enam baim lide chimmutz, shehachittim hem qashim veenam memaharim lehachmitz. Umiyyad achar gemar halletita tzarik letachanam, shello yihyeh lahem shehut lehachmitz. Abal asur liltot et hasseorim veshibbolet shual veshipon, shehem rakkim umemaharim lehachmitz, veyesh lachosh shemma yabou lide chimmutz bishat halletita:

Vekol zeh middina digmara, abal haggeonim aseru kol letita apillu shel chittim, lepi sheen anu beqiin liltot yapeh shello yabou lide chimmutz bishat halletita, veod shemma yishhu meat achar gemar halletita qodem hattechina veyabou lide chimmutz. Umikkol maqom, lo aseru ella baakila, abal muttar lehashhot hachittim halletutim. Raq sheyyizzaher letachanam miyyad achar halletita, abal im lo techanam miyyad ella shahu belichluach hammayim shealehem kede hilluk mil — asur lehashhotam, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"z ayyen sham:

Bimqomot shedderek hattochanim lirchotz hachittim qodem hattechina — yesh lehazhir lahamon am shello yiqchu chittim mibbaal harechayim, lepi shehu loqeach middot chittim mikkol chittim hannitchanim etzlo kol hashshana umokero laacherim:

Saqqim shennotenim bahem qemach kol hashshana, im rotzeh litten bahem qemach shel pesach — lo day lahem bekibbus betzonen, ella tzerikin kibbus bechammin im eper vachabita (perush hakkaot shehakkobes makkeh al habbegadim bishat kebisatan), lepi shehaqqemach haddabuq bassaq naaseh batzeq al yede mayim tzonenin umitdabbeq yoter bassaq, veeno niprad mimmennu, vaapillu yekabbesennu kamma peamim betzonen, ad sheyyekabbesennu bechammin im eper vachabita. Veken mappa shehayeta munnachat al saq shel qemach apillu shel pesach, im rotzeh leekol aleha bepesach — lo day lah beniur velo bekibbus betzonen, ella tzarik lekabbesah bechammin im eper vachabita:

Veqodem hakkibbus tzarik lehattir kol hattepirot shebbiqtzot hassaqqim, veken hattepirot shebbaimera sheal sepato. Veim hem metullaim — tzarik lehattir kol hattepirot shebbattelaim qodem hakkibbus, shehaqqemach shebbetok hattepirot eno yotze al yede kibbus. Vaapillu saqqim chadashim shennatan bahem paam achat qemach shel pesach, im rotzeh lekabbesam tzarik lehattir kol hattepirot shebbahem qodem hakkibbus. Umikkol maqom, bediabad apillu saqqim yeshanim shello hittir hattepirot shebbahem qodem hakkibbus venatan bahem qemach shel pesach — yesh lehattir haqqemach lepesach:

Vekol zeh meiqqar haddin, abal mitzva min hammubchar lemi sheepshar lo sheyyiqneh lo saqqim chadashim lepesach, ki rachoq haddabar shello yihyeh mashshehu batzeq dabuq beechad minniqbe hassaq achar hakkibbus:

Tzarik lemaher litchon hachittim yom o yomayim qodem hallisha, dehaynu sheim epshar lo yireh sheyyehe shehut b' yamim ben hattechina lehallisha. Veim i epshar lo sheyyihyeh benehem shehut b' yamim — yishtaddel sheyyihyeh shehut benehem yom echad meet leet, ulepachot tehe mapseqet benehem linat layla, shehallayla meqarer et haqqemach shehaya roteach bishat hattechina. Abal bo bayyom shennitchan adayin hu roteach, veim yalush oto bo bayyom — hare hu mechammem et hammayim, veal yede ken haissa nocha lehachmitz. Vaapillu nitchan beereb pesach asur lalush oto bo bayyom. Umikkol maqom, im abar velash oto bo bayyom shennitchan — en leesor haissa lepesach, veyishmerenna heteb mechimmutz, dehaynu sheyyaasoq bah bizrizut yoter mishshear issot:

Keshemmolikin hassaqqim sheyyesh bahen qemach min harechayim o mishshear maqom — asur lehannicham al gabbe sus o chamor sheen alayv ukkap o or ab tachat hassaqqim, lepi shehaqqemach mitchammem begup habbehema keshemmunnach al gabbah mammash, veal yede ken hu memaher lehachmitz bishat hallisha, veod shergilut habbehemot hu lehazzia tachat kobed hammassa, veyesh lehistappeq shemma zeat habbehema hi mechammetzet kemo mayim. Umikkol maqom, im abar venatan hassaqqim al gabbe gup habbehema mammash — en leesor haqqemach lepesach, lepi shehaddaat nota shezzeat habbehema hi doma lezeat adam sheenah mechammetzet, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"v. Umikkol maqom, tzarik sheyyihyeh shehut yom o yomayim ben holaka zo lehallisha, leqarer et haqqemach shennitchammem miggup habbehema:

Yesh lizzaher lekattechilla bemaqom sheepshar shello lehanniach harbeh saqqim im qemach zeh al gabbe zeh, shello yitchammem haqqemach shebbassaqqim hattachtonim mechamat kobed massa saqqim haelyonim shealehem. Veim abar vehinnicham — yamtin yom o yomayim qodem hallisha kemo shennitbaer. Veken tob lizzaher lekattechilla shello lesheb al saq sheyyesh bo qemach shel pesach, shello yitchammem haqqemach mechamat kobed yeshibato:

Nahagu kol yisrael lenaqqer harechayim qodem sheyyitchanu bahem qemach shel pesach, lepi shellipamim tachanu bahem tebua letuta lesolet. Vekol shekken bimdinot ellu shekkol hashshana tochanin bahem seorim chamutzim (sheqqorin mal"tz) beodam lachim qetzat venidbaqim meod barechayim:

Venohagin sheqqemach harishon shennitchan barechayim leachar shenniqqeru otam en okelin oto bepesach (shechosheshin shemma lo niqqeru otam heteb venishar dabuq bahem meat qemach chametz venitareb mimmennu letok qemach zeh harishon, lepikak) matzniin oto ad leachar happesach, o okelin oto qodem happesach. Veakshayv shennahagu lekassot (sebib) harechayim bebeged pishtan achar hanniqqur — yesh lehattir gam haqqemach harishon lepesach:

Vekol zeh keshettochen betok l' yom shellipne happesach, abal keshettochen qodem l' yom — yesh lehattir litchon beli niqqur harechayim, shehare meiqqar haddin lo haya tzarik lenaqqeram ap betok l' yom, sheap im yitareb meat chametz letok haqqemach shel pesach hare hu mitbattel betoko beshishshim qodem happesach, veeno chozer veneor bepesach ledibre hakkol im opeh mimmennu hammatztzot qodem happesach kemo shennitbaer lemala, ella shennahagu lehachamir ulenaqqeram, veqodem l' yom lo chal alayv chobat minhag zeh, kemo shello chal adayin kol taqqanot chakamim shettiqqenu biglal happesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tal"[v]. Veap betok l' yom, im hu sheat haddechaq shei epshar beqal lenaqqer harechayim, vegam i epshar lehamtin ad sheyyihyeh epshar lenaqqeram ki hu samuk lepesach — maamidin al iqqar haddin, umuttar litchon beli niqqur harechayim im tochen qodem happesach. Umikkol maqom, tob lizzaher leepot kol hammatztzot qodem happesach, mittaam shennitbaer lemala:

Tzarik lizzaher shello yitchanu (qodem) [qemach] lepesach bebet harechayim beshaa shettochanin bo tebua letuta. Ap al pi shettochanin otah berechayim acheret rachoq meharechayim sherotzim litchon bahem qemach lepesach, mikkol maqom haabaq shellah poreach umitareb beqemach shel pesach, kevan sheshshenehem bebayit echad. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyadua lanu sheotah tebua hi letuta, abal im en haddabar yadua beberur — nahagu lehaqel im tochanan qodem happesach, shehare ap im otah tebua hi letuta venitareb haabaq shellah beqemach shel pesach — en issur bediabad, shehare nitbattel beshishshim qodem happesach, veeno chozer veneor bepesach:

Anshe maaseh hamdaqdeqim bemitzvot regilin lelek beatzmam el meqom harechayim lirot hem beatzmam techinat qimchehem, shekken hu bekol hammitzvot: "mitzva bo yoter mibbishlucho", vekak hayu nohagin gedole chakme haggemara:
